svg.text: Panel A: Family A (strongly connected) global efficiency vs arc count L
Panel B: Family A average path length vs arc count L
Panel C: Family A diameter vs arc count L
Panel D: Family B (DAG/disconnected) E vs density (all on boundary)
Global efficiency = (1/(N(N-1))) sum over reachable ordered pairs of 1/d(i,j); unreachable pairs contribute 0.
